questions.q: The length of the MAVLink 2 header including the STX byte:
questions.explain: STX, len, incompat, compat, seq, sysid, compid, msgid(3) = 10.

questions.q: Why is CRC_EXTRA mixed into the CRC?
questions.explain: If message definitions diverge, the frame is dropped; otherwise different dialects with the same length would produce garbage fields.

questions.q: The COMMAND_LONG payload length in a frame is less than 33 bytes. This is:
options: A sender error: the frame is truncated
questions.explain: The receiver pads it with zeros to the full size.

questions.q: The order of message fields on the wire:
options: By type size, extensions at the end
In the order the fields are declared in the XML
questions.explain: That's how mavgen aligns the struct.

questions.q: Adding an extension field to an existing message:
questions.explain: Extension fields are not part of CRC_EXTRA.
There's no encryption; for confidentiality — a VPN or an encrypting radio.

questions.q: How does a receiver count lost frames?
options: By RSSI and the CRC error counter

questions.q: The signing key is passed to ArduPilot with:
options: PARAM_SET over the radio with the key
questions.explain: Usually over USB; it's stored in flash.

questions.q: Your MAVLink 2 decoder rejects frames from the telemetry radio modem. Start of the frame:
options: Start byte 0xFE is MAVLink 1: the port is configured for v1 or the modem forwards v1
Bad CRC: the modem reorders bytes, so the decoder can't find the end of the frame
This message is signed: length 0x1c includes 13 signature bytes that are missing
msgid 0x1e doesn't exist in common.xml, so the frame is dropped as a foreign dialect
questions.explain: MAVLink 2 starts with 0xFD, MAVLink 1 with 0xFE; the header has a different length.
